content: Step two replaces the cyclopentyl cap - the greasiest in my set, and the second reason this molecule sits at LogP 5 - with a cyclopropyl. Atom 1 is the carbonyl and atom 22 the cyclopentane CH; if the numbering has shifted the two will simply not be bonded and the call fails without damage. Between the pyrazole and the lighter cap this should come in around 333 Da at LogP near 3.0 with QED in the mid 0.8s, and cap ring size has measured activity-neutral five times now, so the 0.70 should survive if the pyrazole holds it.
